transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I... I guess I'm here because I just don't care about anything anymore. I used to do art classes, board-game nights, hiking... I was even thinking about getting back into soccer. But now... I don't know. I just sit in my room. Everything is just sort of... slipping away.
Have you been feeling depressed or down?
Yeah... I guess so. Most days, I just wake up with this... heavy, hollow feeling in my chest. It just feels like... like there's no future for me beyond the apartment walls. So... yeah.
Have you ever had a period lasting at least two weeks when you felt depressed nearly every day?

Yeah... I mean, it's been a lot longer than two weeks. Most of the time since... since everything started getting bad, I haven't just been confused or whatever. I've just been really down. I don't care about anything anymore. It just feels like... like my life is already over.
Have you ever heard voices when no one else was there?

I... yeah. Sometimes. 

Um... there's a woman's voice. She usually talks from the corner of my room. She just... she tells me that I ruined everything. That I should just stay inside. 

I don't really like talking about it, but... it's not just in my head. It sounds completely real. Just as clear as if someone were standing right next to my bed.
Do you ever hear that woman's voice when you are not feeling depressed?

Yeah... I think so. Um... before the really heavy feeling started, there was a stretch where I was still somewhat okay. Like, I could still cook sometimes... or answer my friends when they checked on me. 

But... she was already there. For a few weeks, I was already hearing her. And... I don't really know how to explain it, but I was already thinking the lights in the hallway were... signals. About me. So... yeah. It started before the worst of the depression set in.

Was there ever a period of at least 2 weeks when you were hearing the voice or thinking the hallway lights were signaling about you, but you were not feeling depressed most of the day nearly every day?

Yeah... like I just said. It was... at least a few weeks. 

Before I got really down and stopped doing things... I was still cooking a little, answering my friends... but she was already talking to me. And the lights. So... yeah. It was a few weeks of that before the depression really hit.
Has there ever been a period of at least two weeks when you felt depressed nearly every day, but were not hearing the woman's voice or thinking the hallway lights were signaling about you?

Um... no. I don't think so. 

For most of this past year... they just happen at the same time. I'll just be lying in bed feeling... hopeless... and she's right there, telling me I ruined everything. So... no. Usually it's both.
